notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard resign-time deletion of delete-privileged objects. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the NO_ACTION ownership failure, DELETE_OBJECTS removal delivery, producer and tag metadata, object-name invalidation, and standard cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador resignFederationExecution deletion actions, object registration and identity queries with FederateAmbassador discovery and removal callbacks
